verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.together.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a documentation index. Docs pages are also served as .md files that point agents to the llms.txt index. On top of that, Together documents a Docs MCP server that gives agents live access to the documentation, plus agent skills that teach agents correct Together AI code, so every part of the story is covered by both first-party docs and hands-on probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.together.ai/llms.txt # Together AI docs
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.together.ai/llms.txt
Docs MCP server: Gives your agent live access to this documentation site so it can look up current information without leaving your editor.
Make your AI coding agent Together-AI-aware with ready-made skills for code generation and an MCP server for live docs lookup.
